subject: stf
title: (R)STF.------SOC.RT.
description: First of two diagrams in PMBA-9 (Popular Music from the Black Aesthetic). The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'The emergence of rock and roll would signal the nature of the next transfer cycle in western culture, and on a physical universe level, this phenomenon would manifest itself in the cross-transfer shift of black popular music. Thus, the attraction this form would have in the white community would serve as the strongest factor to solidify moves towards real alternative options (with regard to life thrust).' The crossing diagrams how the reality of source-transfer structurally meets social-reality at the rock-and-roll transfer-cycle scale: (R)STF (the reality of source transfer) crossed with SOC-RT (social reality — the partner-axis's receiving cultural conditions). STF sits on the left with the subject-arrow; APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) at top-center branches from POL-DY's line, POL-SIGN (political significance) from APP-RDEF's line, and EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) at the top from POL-SIGN's line. SOC-RT sits at right as partner-axis. PER-DY (perception dynamics) branches from the main line at right; PRI-INFO (principle information) drops from PER-DY's line, OBS (observation) branches from PRI-INFO's line, and INFO-DY (information dynamics) from OBS's line. POL-DY (political dynamics) sits at the upper-left as the subject's upper output. ALT-FT (alternative functionalism) hangs at the lower-left as the subject's downward output, with CULT-INFO-BS (culture information basis) branching from ALT-FT's line and MD-DY (media dynamics) from CULT-INFO-BS's line. The subject's POL-DY upward and ALT-FT downward outputs are what source-transfer produces alone.
